tools.name: what_can_you_do
tools.description: Describe a task in plain language (any language) and get back exactly which tools on this server do it, with ready-to-run example calls — instead of reading the whole catalogue and guessing. Also returns multi-step recipes when a task needs several tools chained (invoices to a ledger, a bank stateme

tools.name: package_info
tools.description: Latest version, license, repo, description, dependencies and weekly downloads for any public package. Use it before adding a dependency, or to check whether the version in a lockfile is current.

tools.name: check_vulns
tools.description: Query OSV.dev for known CVE/GHSA vulnerabilities affecting a package (optionally a specific version), and get the versions they were fixed in. Use it when reviewing dependencies or a lockfile. Covers npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, NuGet and Packagist.

tools.name: transpile_sql
tools.description: Convert a SQL statement from one dialect to another — mysql, postgres, sqlite, tsql, oracle, snowflake, bigquery, redshift, spark, hive, presto, trino, duckdb, clickhouse, databricks, doris, starrocks and more. Deterministic parser (sqlglot), not an LLM: the same input always produces the same outpu

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Current weather and short forecast for a city or coordinates. Works for Chinese cities too.

tools.name: china_reachability
tools.description: Fetch a URL from a real mainland-China network egress and report HTTP status, latency and China DNS resolution. Answers "is my site/API usable from China?" with a measurement instead of a guess — you cannot get this from a VPS abroad.

tools.name: exchange_rate
tools.description: Live currency exchange rate: one pair with conversion, or a major-currency table for a base currency.

tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: Check if a domain is registered via official RDAP: availability, registrar, created/expiry dates, nameservers.

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.description: Inspect the TLS certificate of a domain: issuer, validity window, days until expiry, trust status, SANs.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Live air quality for any city: US/European AQI, PM2.5, PM10, ozone.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: IP address geolocation and ISP: country, region, city, ISP, timezone.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_weather" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current weather and 3-day forecast for any city worldwide (city name in any language, or coordinates)." → after: "Current weather and short forecast for a city or coordinates. Works for Chinese cities too."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "stock_quote" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "china_reachability" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
